crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin back above $80,000 after the Binance hack sell-off
crypto_headlines.summary: BTC fell to $75,700 after the record $6.3B Binance hack, then broke out of a 43-day falling wedge and climbed back past $80,000; traders now watch resistance at $82,000.

crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs take in $127M after the midterms
crypto_headlines.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs added $74.57M on Nov 4, led by Fidelity's FBTC at $236.72M while BlackRock's IBIT saw $201.2M out; Ethereum ETFs added $53.02M, ending a five-day outflow run.

crypto_headlines.title: Binance users bring $3.4B back after the record hack
crypto_headlines.summary: Binance says it covered the $6.3B theft from company funds, replenished 98% of affected assets and froze $2.85B; withdrawals resume in phases starting Nov 5.

crypto_headlines.title: Binance disables SignalPlus API keys as a precaution
crypto_headlines.summary: Binance cut all API keys tied to the third-party platform SignalPlus over a potential security issue and told users to check accounts and enable IP whitelisting.

crypto_headlines.title: Polygon proposes a hard fork to recover 70.49M stolen POL
crypto_headlines.summary: A Polygon Labs proposal would zero out five attacker addresses holding POL taken from Binance and Polymarket in late October and send it to recovery wallets; discussion is set for Nov 5.

crypto_headlines.title: Solana lender Loopscale pauses after API attacks
crypto_headlines.summary: Attacks on Loopscale's vaults had about $952,000 in impact; the team says user funds are secure and it is working with law enforcement before resuming.

doginal_news.title: Doginal Dogs thanks the community
doginal_news.summary: The official account posted a note of thanks: grateful for the Doginal Dogs community, every single day.

doginal_news.title: Team replacements estimated at more than $500K
doginal_news.summary: Prowlytics reports the team used its own NFTs to replace collectibles stolen from holders in late October, with the replacements valued at more than $500,000 by the team's estimate.

doginal_news.title: Cherry joins the Legends beta
doginal_news.summary: Cherry, a new 4-cost Bow creature with a 3/3 body, summons a creature costing 2 or less from your deck when played.

doginal_news.title: Rise of the Pack card reveals: Penny, Chart and Chum
doginal_news.summary: More first edition cards from Legends: Rise of the Pack were shown, including Penny (6-cost pirate that summons from the graveyard), Chart (V017) and Chum The Water (V089).

doginal_news.title: How Pyth powered Kalshi's KPOW Midterms index
doginal_news.summary: Pyth posted a thread on how it calculated and published every KPOW Midterms index value as Kalshi's exclusive source agency.

doginal_news.title: PIRB: first $1M month for Pyth, 600K to the DAO
doginal_news.summary: Pyth's community account says Pyth had its first $1M and that 600K went to the DAO, with buyback funds home.

notes: No new posts from @DDLTCG in the last day, and no news on Toot, Atlas or Boogie.
